name: Zephaniah
bio: Zephaniah, a descendant of Hizkiah through Amariah, Gedaliah, and Cushi, prophesied during the reign of King Josiah of Judah. He warned of a coming "day of the LORD" that would sweep away idolatry and complacency from Judah and Jerusalem, pronounced judgment on the surrounding nations, and condemned Jerusalem's corrupt officials and prophets. The book closes with a promise of a purified remnant and a joyful restoration, as the LORD himself would rejoice over his people and gather the scattered exiles home (Zephaniah 1:1-3:20). He is a different figure from Zephaniah, the priest sent to Jeremiah.
